summary: The design fits existing wiki, lint, skill, SDD CLI, and hook seams, but several integration contracts are underspecified. The largest risks are the absent FEAT-887 runtime surface, stale-index consistency, probe cost in hooks, and unclear procedure-state semantics.

suggestions.title: Define the FEAT-887 integration contract before implementation
suggestions.rationale: The repository has a PreToolUse-only wiki hook, but no checked-in experience_hook.py or shared FEAT-887 entry point. The implementation needs an explicit dependency or adapter boundary; otherwise it will either duplicate hook registration or target nonexistent files.

suggestions.title: Keep procedure hook evaluation on a dedicated stdlib fast path
suggestions.rationale: The existing hook rejects ordinary Bash payloads before loading Pydantic/configuration and has subprocess import-time tests. Procedure matching must use compiled JSON and a narrow Bash prefilter before any SQLite, Pydantic, YAML, or skill-parser import; otherwise the stated millisecond requirement will regress.

suggestions.title: Specify an atomic compiled-index publication protocol
suggestions.rationale: SQLiteWikiStore already tracks source hashes and supports read-only handles, but there is no compiled-index contract. Define schema/version, source hashes, generation identity, incomplete-build handling, and temp-file plus os.replace publication; the hook should read one complete snapshot and stay silent on any mismatch.

suggestions.title: Separate procedure requirements into typed fields
suggestions.rationale: The proposed requires field combines facts, probes, procedures, and tools, while ProcedureSpec also combines kind, mode, executor, confirmation, and source. This makes validation and cycle detection ambiguous. Use discriminated models or separate typed collections so illegal combinations and requires cycles are rejected deterministically.

suggestions.title: Make the skill producer preserve graph metadata explicitly
suggestions.rationale: SkillDefinition currently contains only skill metadata and the parser manually selects optional frontmatter fields. Adding fields to the model alone will not make graph metadata available unless parsers copy and validate it; malformed graph fields should fail or be logged according to the existing discovery contract, while skills without graph fields remain unchanged.

suggestions.title: Reuse the existing source-slice and provenance mechanisms
suggestions.rationale: SQLiteWikiStore already provides source_id, content_hash, typed edges with provenance, page attributes, read-only access, and atomic replace_source_slice. A procedure plane should use these contracts rather than introducing parallel hash, edge, and replacement semantics; only resolver-specific indexes/query methods should be specialized.

suggestions.title: Constrain hook probes to bounded local evidence
suggestions.rationale: The proposed probes include branch-pushed and PR-open checks, which can require GitHub or gh subprocesses and violate the hook latency/failure constraints. Define probe cost classes: local probes may run synchronously, remote probes should be cached or return unknown in hooks, and the CLI may perform the complete evaluation.

suggestions.title: Define how the resolver knows the last completed procedure
suggestions.rationale: The SDD task-state checker detects stalled files but does not record procedure-step completion. Ordering by next edges therefore lacks a durable input. Add an explicit state projection or event/ledger mapping from command completion to procedure id, with deterministic behavior when no completion history exists.

suggestions.title: Treat mandatory confirmation as future metadata, not current authorization
suggestions.rationale: ConfirmationGuard authorizes individual tools through routing metadata and raises HumanInteractionInterrupt for SUSPEND. The pilot only announces mandatory procedures, so v1 must not imply that confirm grants a procedure-wide tool authorization. Document the field as inert in v1 and specify future grant scope, declared-tool validation, expiry, and edited-argument behavior before dispatch is enabled.

suggestions.title: Integrate the manifest into the existing packaged-asset lifecycle
suggestions.rationale: SDD assets are installed from parrot.sdd/_assets/manifest.json with receipt-based upgrade/uninstall behavior, while the proposed graph adds a YAML manifest and repo-local overlay. The implementation needs installer manifest entries, receipt/conflict behavior, package-data coverage, twin-drift lint tests, and a wheel-only release smoke test.
